name: Peñausende (Spain)
description: Three triangles from the lower hoist: white above with a red cross of Saint James, red in the centre and green below.
history: The arms and municipal flag were approved by the full council of Peñausende in its session of 2 March 2005 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 7 February 2007; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of three triangles with a common vertex at the lower hoist corner and the others at the upper fly corner and the centre of the fly, the upper triangle white with a red cross of Saint James at a third of the hoist, the central red and the lower green.

features.role: upper triangle from the lower hoist to the upper fly
cross of Saint James at a third of the length
